response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(spatial_count) AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT sc.source, sc.spatial_count, 1.0 * sc.spatial_count / t.total_count AS share, sc.spatial_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE sc.spatial_count > t.average_count
